frame: civic-block.json block frame in integer centimetres: x south, y east. Mission clock in seconds from 0:00 (the engine ticks at 10 Hz).
src: brief 059 §5 (Splice): getaway.stands[] and rivals.car / rivals.posts, derived from the mission points (Vantage), the mission routes getaway, getaway-service and rivals, and the plan, held by SX-2 and SX-3 (tools/sim/stands.ts). A second file so the site keeps the shape the engine reads (Site.cs rejects a key it does not know): `bun run sim:site --fold-stands` moves it into the site (getaway.stands, rivals.car, rivals.posts) when Keel's 059 round reads it there, and this file is then not written

exit.src: mission.json routes "getaway" (r_orbit_w to off_southside), its first road rocket-lane (plan.roads w 12 m); the car's bay "Getaway bay" projected onto it, walked forward fight-block-m 30 m (rulebook). points: site frame, cm; w: metres. Brief 018 §1, tools/sim/getaway.ts

stands.src: brief 059 §1.4 and §5: the getaway car's stand square (d:Getaway bay); exit = the carriageway ahead of the car along mission route "getaway" (fight-block-m); ambush and police = the mission points /^ambush-\d+$/ and /^police-\d+$/, in number order; rivalStop = where the rival car stops for it (rival-drop); facing = nose along the bay's long axis the way the exit lane runs (block frame, 100 = one axis step)

exit.src: mission.json routes "getaway-service" (r_apron_w to r_apron_e), its first road apron-road (plan.roads w 12 m); the car's stand at block (69.35, -15) projected onto it, walked forward fight-block-m 30 m (rulebook). points: site frame, cm; w: metres. Brief 018 §1, tools/sim/getaway.ts

stands.src: brief 059 §1.4 and §5: the getaway car's stand service-drive (service-drive); exit = the carriageway ahead of the car along mission route "getaway-service" (fight-block-m); ambush and police = the mission points /^svc-ambush-\d+$/ and /^svc-police-\d+$/, in number order; rivalStop = where the rival car stops for it (rival-tail); facing = nose out along the drive's long axis, away from the bay (block frame, 100 = one axis step)

route.src: mission.json routes "rivals" (off_seagates through r_orbit_e, r_orbit_w, r_apron_w to r_pylon_s): the plan road centrelines in travel order, cut to the walk window where it enters (rival-car-entry's edge); points: site frame, cm; chain: where each rival point projects, cm along the polyline from its start. Brief 059 §5, tools/sim/stands.ts

car.src: brief 059 §2.2 and §5, Pulse's rival routine (briefs/059/pulse/rival-routine.md §9, K10) and Vantage's mission points: the rival car enters at entry, stops at drop to drop three, parks at park; tail is where it stops when it follows Vale's car (and the service-drive stand's rival stop), front where a crew drawn by gunfire stops; facing = the route's direction at each point (block frame, 100 = one axis step; the front stop's heading is the engine's, from the route it rides); route is derived from mission route "rivals". Values are place ids (mission.json points)

posts.src: the crew on foot (mission.json points): the lookout's post, where a warned lookout leaves the map, and the wheelman's place at Vale's car. Place ids
